author: The Infographics Show
description:
Professional athletes can earn millions before they turn 25, and still end up broke only a few years after retirement.

This video explores the dark side of pro sports wealth and why sudden success can become a financial trap. Huge contracts are quickly reduced by federal and state taxes, agent fees, loans, lifestyle inflation, family obligations, and bad investments. Some athletes even enter the professional leagues already owing money against their future earnings. The biggest problem is time. An NFL career may last only a few years, while injuries can end everything overnight. That means athletes have a very short window to turn temporary income into lifelong financial security. Add entourages, predatory lenders, complicated “jock taxes,” and the pressure to maintain a celebrity lifestyle, and even enormous salaries can disappear surprisingly fast.

For many athletes, the contract is only the beginning. The real challenge is making the money last after the cheering stops.

title: Why Millionaire Athletes Go Broke: The Dark Side of Pro Sports Wealth
